_comment: TYPECHECK-ONLY CONFIG FOR THE EXPLORER HARNESS. It emits nothing and is never built.
WHY IT EXISTS: Playwright STRIPS TypeScript types rather than checking them. A spec compiles-and-runs
with a call to a function that was never imported, a missing argument, or a wrong type -- right up
until the line actually executes, at which point it is a ReferenceError inside a test rather than a
compile error in CI. Twenty-one spec files had never been typechecked once. Three real defects were
sitting in committed code when this was first run.
WHAT IT READS -- DO NOT 'FIX' THIS INTO READING dist/: `include` names .ts SOURCES under specs/ and
lib/ and nothing else, and `noEmit` is true. This harness has no build output, and pointing a checker
at build output is precisely how a stale artefact gets certified as green -- this repo has been bitten
from both directions already (a mutation surviving in dist/ after its source was restored, and a
junctioned node_modules silently resolving an import to a DIFFERENT package's pre-change dist).
A gate that reads generated output tests the generator, not the code someone just wrote.
`strict` is on deliberately. The three defects found on the first run were a missing import and two
missing arguments -- all caught by ordinary checking, none needing an exotic flag.
`skipLibCheck` is on for the same reason every other tsconfig here sets it: the target is THIS
